Property Fire Insurance

Your business property is more than just a building—it’s the foundation of your operations. But fire, flood, theft, and natural disasters can strike without warning, causing costly damage and disruption.

Property Insurance helps you recover quickly and keeps your business moving forward.

At TRINITY, we offer a comprehensive Property Fire Insurance Indemnity Insurance that provides protection for properties and assets against loss or damage caused by fire or lightning and can be extended to cover earthquake, typhoon, flood, other insurable perils, and loss of income from the insured perils.

Property Fire Insurance can cover the following:
• Broad Named Perils (e.g. earthquake, typhoon, flood)

• Clients have the option to include extended coverage which are as follows:
o Explosion
o Smoke damage
o Falling aircraft
o Vehicle impact
o Riot strike and malicious damage
o Broad water damage
o Bursting and/or overflowing of water tanks apparatus and pipes.

Optional Special Packages:
• Comprehensive General/Personal Liability
• Robbery
• Machinery Breakdown
• Plate Glass Insurance
• Loss of Money within and outside premises
• Fidelity Guarantee
• Personal Accident Insurance
• Business Interruption (for commercial and industrial risk)
• Loss of income

What is the information needed for Property Fire Insurance?
• Assured's Name
• Location of Property
• Type of Property - commercial, industrial, or residential

• Properties to be Insured
o Building
o Contents
o Machineries and equipment
o Stocks
o Valuable items/works of art

• Valuation of Property
o Replacement Value - amount if a similar property will be built NOW
o Sound Value - replacement value less the accrued depreciation
o Fair Market Value - value of a similar property in the market

• Mortgage, if applicable
• Loss history
• Broker of Record (BOR) - form will be provided by Trinity
• KYC form – form will be provided by Trinity
